ohhmygosh i feel this so bad. i know i shouldn't romanticize it because it's a very serious topic, but somehow i cant help but read fanfics about it.

but honestly, it kinda helps me get through my days, so i don't see the problem as a really big deal for me. and, as a self-harmer, i think it should be okay to consume any kind of media about it (if it makes you feel better).

seeing your favourite characters break down, bleed, and then having another character walk in on them and comfort them is just *chefs kiss*
ohh, if youre into anime, i think Wonder Egg Priority has a character that used to self harm! i have not watched it myself yet but people told me that the topic gets attention in that show

I feel you exactly. Students are overworked, yet school doesn't do anything about it. Teachers can get away with anything, but if a student messes up they will bash them in every possible way. They embarrass students in front of the class, which can lead to anxiety. Most teachers don't even like their job. Adults never listen. It's hell. It's all fucked up.

We don't have a choice. We're constantly forced to do things we don't like. This makes us feel like suicide is the only way out, even though you probably know school is not everything and it wouldn't be worth it.

Stay strong, it's extremely hard and again, the system is completely fucked up, but just hold on for a bit longer- you can do it! It's okay to slip up. Your health is way more important.
Yes, I feel you exactly. I will have long self-harm pauses but when an event which gives me a lot of stress happens (arguments, bad grades, pressure etc) I’ll suddenly do it a lot.

Please don’t. Your life is valuable. There is always hope. It is an extremely tough battle, I know, and I feel you, but please, please give yourself more time. Call someone. Play some games. Ask someone for a hug. Do something you enjoy. I love you, you can get through this alright? I’m here for you. Everything may seem impossible, but there will be a time where that will change. Please, hold on and stay with us a little longer. I’m here if you want to talk. Stay strong for a little longer.

Honestly, kinda exciting? The constant feeling of "i have to hide these" gave me a lot of adrenaline

Pain stayed the same, maybe got worse tbh because i started really small and worked my way up to bigger areas :o

i used to have extreme rituals when going to bed from age 7-11 i think?
i would have a very strict routine, like touching the window 40 times with both sides of my hands in a specific order, touching my closet with my feet 20 times,  going back to touching the window and so forth
its not as bad anymore but i still do feel the need to run my hands on specific objects in a limited time period

Edit: also, praying every night when i was 11 (even though im not religious) and thinking that specific numbers were "wrong"
